classification.nature: STRUCTURAL_PEFT_INITIALIZATION (Standard PEFT Kaiming A / Zero B)
classification.honest_statement: The LoRA adapter contains structurally valid PEFT weight tensors (Rank 16, Alpha 32, 252 tensors) initialized according to standard LoRA specification (Kaiming A / Zero B). Full backpropagation fine-tuning is ready via app/build/dataset/vivva_training_dataset.jsonl upon GPU CUDA resource allocation.
